sdk_contract.note: The SDK consumes API_KEY as configuration; Studio recognizes the public marker. This is not a cloud token.

runtime_snapshot.loading: The launcher sources AO_ENV_FILE, defaulting to .local/real.env, before exec. The example file is not sourced. Generator allow-list entries alone are not populated configuration.

scope: Operator-supplied local setup/profile boundary. SDK and Studio compatibility are known configuration inputs, not live transport evidence. No Studio process, credentials, cloud, model, service startup, dependency installation, or endpoint discovery is requested.
